purpose: Check whether the selected AC1024 ACIS 700 SAT serialization can be parsed by an independent SAT reader and built as a valid native FreeCAD Part solid.

extractedSab.header: ACIS BinaryFile v700, recordCount=0, terminal marker present

odaSatReference.extractedFrom: ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0 ACAD2010 DXF export using ezdxf 1.4.5

runtime.execution: FreeCADCmd -c with the checked-in Python probe and the required environment variables, outside the sandbox so Qt could query the host NEON feature

readerAndNativeBuild.compatibilityAdjustment: The unmodified InventorLoader _getNextText header helper rejects standard ACIS 700 @length strings with int('...'). The checked-in probe applies a runtime-only one-method adjustment to accept that prefix. Its record tokenizer, entity builders and FreeCAD Part operations are unchanged.
readerAndNativeBuild.nativeOperations: InventorLoader AcisReader.readText, typed body/lump/shell/face entity builders, face.build, FreeCAD Part.Shell, Part.makeSolid

limitations: This is a single selected cube profile derived from an ODA-produced AC1024 DWG; it is not an Autodesk-native producer sample.
The runtime header compatibility adjustment is research-only and does not change the pinned InventorLoader source or production code.
InventorLoader and FreeCAD Part use the same OpenCASCADE kernel, so the check is not an independent-kernel comparison.
The check uses FreeCAD's native Part library but does not exercise GUI DWG/DXF import or the bundled importerSAT application route.
It does not qualify DWG placement/history, broader ACIS/ACDS profiles, whole-source output admission, or general 3D support.
claimEffect: Adds bounded native FreeCAD Part B-rep and analytic cube measurement evidence for the exact AC1024 ACIS 700 SAT payload. It does not promote DWG, DXF, ACIS/ACDS, or general 3D support claims.
